description: Client-side script for managing security and developer settings in an OpenCart admin dashboard, including modal interactions, AJAX requests for security listing, installation, storage management, admin user management, and developer options.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Initial modal display and accordion trigger on document ready.

methods.name: click #button-refresh
methods.description: Refresh security list via AJAX and update modal content.

methods.name: click #button-install
methods.description: Install security component via AJAX and show success/error alerts.

methods.name: submit #form-storage
methods.description: Handle storage form submission, perform recursive AJAX calls for storage management.

methods.name: click #button-storage-delete
methods.description: Delete storage item via AJAX and show success/error alerts.

methods.name: submit #form-admin
methods.description: Manage admin user via AJAX, handle redirects, and show alerts.

methods.name: click #button-admin-delete
methods.description: Delete admin user via AJAX and show alerts.

methods.name: click #button-setting
methods.description: Open developer settings modal via AJAX.

methods.name: click modal-developer table button
methods.description: Perform developer actions via AJAX and show alerts.
